name: Kartu Kredit UOB Zenith

fees.condition: cannot be waived, by spending or otherwise

welcomeBonus: 58.700 UOB Points, worth 10.000 miles at the current ratio, for Rp 15.000.000 spent over 3 months.
notes: Earning is 1 UOB Point per Rp 1.500 and did not change on 9 January 2026. What changed that day was the conversion: 5 points bought a mile before it and 5,87 after, a cut of about 17%. A mile went from Rp 7.500 to Rp 8.800 without the earning rate moving at all, which is the shape these UOB changes usually take.
The 5,87 is recorded as 587 points for 100 miles, which is the same ratio in whole numbers and is why the transfer step is 587 rather than something rounder.
The card has no ceiling on earning and none on converting, which is unusual in Indonesia and is most of the reason to hold it.
Only KrisFlyer is recorded. UOB converts to other programmes, but no ratio for them on this card could be pinned down, so an estimate for them shows nothing.
The annual fee of Rp 3.500.000 cannot be waived by any amount of spending.
Not modelled: the airport limousine transfer and lounge access, neither of which pays points.
No source could be read directly. UOB's own site and PinterPoin are unreachable from here, so every figure comes from search summaries.
